tools.description: Look up one or more TRON transactions by full hash: sender, receiver, type, result, fee, block. Returns the evidence envelope.

tools.name: explain_sql
tools.description: Check a SQL statement's partitions and estimated cost against the plan limits. Never runs it. Use before run_sql.
